text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Teeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Platypus(x) ::: x is a platypus.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Premises:
∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ ¬Teeth(x)) ::: Some mammals have teeth.
Platypus(platypus) ∧ ¬Teeth(platypus) ::: Platypuses have no teeth.
Mammal(platypus) ::: Platypuses are mammals.
Human(human) ∧ Teeth(human) ::: Humans have teeth.
Conclusion:
Platypus(platypus) ∧ Mammal(platypus) ∧ ¬Teeth(platypus) ::: Platypuses are mammals with no teeth.
